title: Updates Checkout Session UI mode enum values
changed: hosted, embedded and custom removed from checkout.sessions.create ui_mode
elements, embedded_page and hosted_page added to Checkout.Session.ui_mode
Checkout.Session.ui_mode no longer returns hosted, embedded or custom
reason: Equality checks against an old value (`x.field === <old value>`) are not enumChecks, so a renamed or replaced value goes unreported in every mode.

changed: hosted, embedded and custom removed from checkout.sessions.create ui_mode
parts.reason: Only with fullDiff (oasdiff; the watch worker default, off in `refit run` and in the benchmark fix stage): compareOpenApi (openapi-diff.ts) reports the request change and findBreakingOperationImpacts (provider-operations.ts) lists every traced call of that operation as an operation impact, which blocks AI and stops the run in scanReviewReason (workflow.ts), whether or not the call sends the changed value. Without fullDiff Refit reports nothing.

changed: elements, embedded_page and hosted_page added to Checkout.Session.ui_mode
parts.how: Only with fullDiff: compareOpenApi drops Stripe response enum additions (openResponseEnums) and switchedEnumAdditions (openapi-diff.ts) re-adds the new value where the code switches over the field or assigns it to `never` (analyzer.ts enumChecks). unmappedBreakingChanges keeps that entry, so scanReviewReason (workflow.ts) stops the run for review and publication is blocked. Other reads need no edit (AGENTS.md: Stripe response enum additions block only where the code switches over the field). Without fullDiff nothing is reported.

changed: Checkout.Session.ui_mode no longer returns hosted, embedded or custom
parts.reason: Equality checks against an old value (`x.field === <old value>`) are not enumChecks, so a renamed or replaced value goes unreported in every mode.
